PDF blob download survives immediate URL revocation
bridgeCheck.scope: Android document-start JavaScript in Chromium; not an Android device test

openLimitReproduction.scope: Reproduce catalogue/history truncation in isolated in-memory stores.

openFindings.summary: POS search/barcode/offline snapshot only cover first 500 products; complete retrieval/server lookup remains unimplemented
History client search cannot reach older orders omitted by the default 200-order API response
Configured channel/provider preferences do not govern checkout consistently; standalone VA, online card and manual transfer execution are incomplete
Default return URL points to /pos and returned order reference is not consumed by POS; production environment override was not inspected
Stock/report error handlers still show empty data or perpetual loading on failed reads; only payment-configuration retry was fixed in this patch
